author: Skyline Communications
name: DataMiner Assistant Integration
description: Adds SetupContent folders (adhocs, agents, scripts, skills) with guidance for integrating an existing DataMiner package project with the DataMiner Assistant. Run this from the root of the package project.

postActions.description: Wire up the DataMiner Assistant installer call

manualInstructions.text: 1) If the project does not already reference the 'Skyline.DataMiner.Utils.SecureCoding' NuGet package (version matching Skyline.DataMiner.Utils.SecureCoding.Analyzers), add it: dotnet add package Skyline.DataMiner.Utils.SecureCoding. 2) Open the project's install entry point (the .cs file containing the [AutomationEntryPoint(AutomationEntryPointType.Types.InstallAppPackage)] method) and add 'AssistantInstaller.InstallAssistantFiles(installer);' right after 'installer.InstallDefaultContent();' so the Assistant files added to SetupContent get installed.
